name: Rishabh Digha Steel & Allied Products Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Rishabh Digha Steel & Allied Products Ltd is in the business of steel and related services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RDSAPL is an ISO 9002 certified provider of HR / CR Coil Straightening & De-coiling, Cutting of 16mm steel sheets, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.11 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 269 to 174 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of -1.59% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 174 days.
